where: A home in the City of Scottsdale, in Scottsdale Unified School District.
input_label: Limited property value of your home (from the Assessor)
split_note: Arizona splits rates into primary (operations) and secondary (bonds, voter-approved overrides and special districts).
rollback_note: Arizona’s Truth in Taxation law makes a city or county that raises its primary levy above the prior year’s (new construction aside) publish a notice and hold a hearing; no yearly rate is published for every unit here.
limits: Arizona’s homeowner rebate (state aid to education, A.R.S. §15-972) lowers the school primary tax on an owner-occupied home and isn’t modeled; the Treasurer lists this area’s approximate residential primary rate after it as $3.8289 instead of $4.9466 per $100.
ratio_note: Arizona assesses an owner-occupied home at 10% of its limited property value (A.R.S. §42-15003).
